title: LC-MT367-AtomicMutationEventLedgerAndOutbox
clause: Commit every canonical Locus mutation, EventLedger receipt and projection-outbox intent atomically in SurrealDB.

scope.summary: GOAL: Extend the MT-335 atomic EventLedger pattern to every Locus project-forest and governance mutation. One SurrealDB transaction must write the canonical record change, immutable project-qualified EventLedger event and durable projection-outbox intent. Idempotency keys prevent duplicate effects. Filesystem taskboards, Loom projections, GUI caches and search updates occur only from committed outbox items and can be replayed safely. A failed transaction produces none of the three records; a failed projection leaves canonical truth committed and visibly pending repair.
forbidden_paths: Canonical mutation without EventLedger and outbox in the same SurrealDB transaction
Direct filesystem/UI/Loom write before transaction commit
acceptance_criteria: Every mutating Locus operation writes canonical state, one immutable EventLedger event and required outbox intent in one real SurrealDB transaction.
Injected failure before commit leaves no partial canonical, ledger or outbox record; injected projection failure after commit leaves a retryable outbox item without rolling back truth.
Idempotent retry with the same project-qualified operation id creates no duplicate mutation, event or projection effect.
Outbox workers enforce project scope, stable ordering and bounded retry/dead-letter behavior and never open raw database authority to consumers.
Independent canonical reread reconciles record revision, EventLedger sequence and projection source revision after restart and concurrent writes.
proof_targets: Duplicate retry and concurrent append tests
Independent canonical reconciliation command comparing state, ledger and outbox revisions

surfaces: Locus mutation receipt and projection health

enforcement_boundaries: Ledger events and outbox intents inherit the canonical record scope.
Workers cannot process or reveal projects outside their delegated ResourceBroker scope.
same_project_private_resource_cases: A worker delegated to one private AccessSpace cannot consume or diagnose another private space in the same project.
cross_account_negative_cases: Cross-account events and outbox items cannot be claimed, replayed, counted or inspected.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Every projection preserves the canonical mutation scope and cannot promote broader visibility.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Worker delegation revocation stops claims and retries; a new scope requires a new authorized worker context.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Diagnostics expose scoped hashes and ids only and redact content, secrets, hidden queue depth and private target labels.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Record transaction correlation, canonical revision, EventLedger id, outbox id and projection settlement.
Expose partial-state invariant checks, outbox depth, retry age, dead letters and reconciliation mismatches.
Record DEFERRED-with-reason if outbox-stall and ledger-divergence watchers are unavailable; never silently skip.

risk_if_missed: A crash can leave Locus truth, EventLedger and projections disagreeing, destroying reliable recovery and operator trust.

risks: Ledger append succeeds after canonical mutation fails.
minimum_controls: Scoped workers and authenticated privacy tests.

research_provenance.source: MT-335 EventLedger atomicity contract; MT-364 project lifecycle contract; current Locus/taskboard projection paths; official SurrealDB transaction documentation and transactional-outbox field patterns reviewed for WP-017.
research_provenance.selected_approach: Single-database atomic state/event/outbox commit with idempotent post-commit projections.
